runs.summary: 53 finds, 30 of them alerts (34 from the scout run, 19 from the local check). Deseret Alphabet originals: the 1869 Book of Mormon (443 pp.) and a First Book + Second Reader lot at Weiss Auctions on 10 Dec (bids $250), plus Part I ($350) and a Second Reader ($300) on AbeBooks. Also two single Times and Seasons issues (1843, 1844), Millennial Star 1846 ($57), Vols. I and V (1841, 1845), Deseret News 1853 and 1855, and 1849–1886 LDS and anti-Mormon pamphlets. No common cups, Portuguese pre-1960, pre-1900 vessels or wants found. Local check (Chrome): Deseret First Book $150 (Biblio) and two Weller Deseret Second Books ($225, $275); two Book of Mormon Part I copies on eBay ($400–450); Millennial Star 1850 volume $149, 1848–49 volumes $245 and three 1852–54 issues at $12 ending today; anti-Mormon pamphlets (The Mormon Problem 1882, Mormon Expositor 1875); a 1588 Luther Galatians leaf and c. 1550 Luther Bible woodcuts; an 18th-century French chalice (date unconfirmed). Still no common cups, Portuguese pre-1960 items or wants.
